offering_description.value: Itron provides metering systems, communications networks, software and services to utilities, cities and other infrastructure operators. Its systems connect field devices and data to help customers manage energy, water and city services, control distributed energy resources, and improve construction workflows and asset safety.

quotes.quote: Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live and thrive. Join us as we create a more resourceful world.
Itron's AI-powered solutions and digital construction workflows help utilities and infrastructure operators protect people and communities, optimize capital deployment and safeguard assets.
